traits.name: Keepsake
traits.text: (abjuration, primal); The leshy can store an item of light Bulk or less in its head, concealing it as nondetection. If stored for 24 hours, the item benefits from mending.

traits.name: Verdant Burst
traits.text: (healing); As leaf leshy, except plants regain 1d8 (1d8) Hit Points and the area sprouts gourds instead of tree saplings.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text: ⬻ (concentrate, polymorph, primal, transmutation); As leaf leshy, except the gourd leshy transforms into a gourd-bearing plant.

traits.name: Ensnare
traits.text: When the gourd leshy damages a creature with a fist or seed Strike, vines lash out from the leshy (or seed) and wrap around the target's limbs. The target must attempt a DC 17 Reflex save. On a failure, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed for 1 round; on a critical failure, the target is immobilized for 1 round and the penalty to Speed lasts for 1 minute.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fist +7 (agile, finesse); Damage 1d4+2 (1d4+2) bludgeoning plus ensnare

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ seed +9 (range increment 30 feet); Damage 1d6+2 (1d6+2) bludgeoning plus ensnare
